notes: The story centres on Mr. Bird and Mrs. Bird searching for the best nest, eventually returning to their original tree nest when Mrs. Bird lays an egg. Key vocabulary supports retelling the journey: nest-building materials (twig, feather), locations (tree, house), and the resolution (egg, baby, best). 'Sing' is included because Mr. Bird sings 'I love my house' — a repeated refrain central to the book. Mrs. Bird could be added as a secondary character image if the board is extended. Existing activity_images (bird, nest, egg, tree, house) and aac_extras (fly, build, feather, twig) overlap well with recommended fringe — reuse those assets where possible.
